requirements.title: ISHFTC argument restrictions and SIZE default
requirements.definition: I shall be integer, SHIFT shall be integer with ABS(SHIFT) not greater than SIZE, SIZE shall be positive integer not exceeding BIT_SIZE(I), and absent SIZE is treated as BIT_SIZE(I).

pending.ISHFTC-I-integer: Positive control calls ISHFTC with an integer I containing distinguished rightmost and unshifted bits; source-control mutation changes I to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.ISHFTC-SHIFT-integer: Positive control calls ISHFTC with integer SHIFT values -1, 0, and 1; source-control mutation changes SHIFT to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.ISHFTC-SHIFT-magnitude-not-greater-than-: Positive control calls ISHFTC with SHIFT values -SIZE, 0, and SIZE for a positive SIZE; source-control mutations use magnitudes beyond SIZE and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.ISHFTC-SIZE-positive-integer-not-greater: Positive control calls ISHFTC with SIZE=3 and SIZE=BIT_SIZE(I); source-control mutations use SIZE=0 and BIT_SIZE(I)+1 and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.ISHFTC-absent-SIZE-defaults-to-bit-size: Compare ISHFTC(I,1) with ISHFTC(I,1,BIT_SIZE(I)) on an I with distinguished low and high bits, observing equality by BTEST, and mutate the explicit SIZE to BIT_SIZE(I)-1.

requirements.title: ISHFTC result characteristics match I
requirements.definition: The ISHFTC result has the same integer type and kind as I.

pending.ISHFTC-result-same-integer-kind-as-I: Call ISHFTC with default integer I and with selected_int_kind(18) I; 7.4.3.1 p2 requires at least one integer representation method with decimal exponent range >= 18, so selected_int_kind(18) is a valid kind. Assert KIND(ISHFTC(I,1,3)) equals KIND(I) for each call and mutate the I kind used in the expected expression.

requirements.title: ISHFTC circular rightmost-bit shift result value
requirements.definition: The ISHFTC result circularly shifts the SIZE rightmost bits of I left for positive SHIFT, right for negative SHIFT, and not at all for zero SHIFT; no bits are lost and bits outside the shifted field are unaltered.

pending.ISHFTC-positive-left-circular-shift: Use SIZE=4, I with rightmost-field bits 0 and 1 set, and SHIFT=1; observe by BTEST that rightmost-field bits 1 and 2 are set while bit 3 is clear, and mutate SHIFT sign to rotate the opposite direction.
pending.ISHFTC-negative-right-circular-shift: Use SIZE=4, I with rightmost-field bits 0 and 1 set, and SHIFT=-1; observe by BTEST that rightmost-field bits 0 and 3 are set while bit 2 is clear, and mutate SHIFT sign to rotate the opposite direction.
pending.ISHFTC-zero-shift-preserves-bits: Use SIZE=5, I with rightmost-field bits 0, 2, and 4 set plus an outside bit; assert all selected BTEST values match I and mutate SHIFT to 1.
pending.ISHFTC-no-bits-lost-in-rightmost-field: Use SIZE=4 and a bit at position 3 with SHIFT=1; assert by BTEST that it wraps to bit 0 rather than being cleared, and mutate SIZE to 5 to change the wrap point.
pending.ISHFTC-unshifted-bits-unaltered: Use SIZE=4 with bits 5 and BIT_SIZE(I)-2 set outside the shifted field; assert those BTEST positions remain set and mutate SIZE to include bit 5.
